senses.gloss: ऋजिप्य॑ mfn. (fr. ऋजु and √ आप्, Sāy. ?), going straight upwards, moving upwards, RV.;
ऋजिप्य [cf. Zd. ĕrĕzifya.]
ऋजीपि॑न् mfn. id., RV. iv, 26, 6.
ऋजिमन् See col. 3.
ऋजिमन् m. straightness g. पृथ्व्-आदि, Pāṇ. v, 1, 122.
ऋजि॑श्वन् m. N. of a king (protected by Indra), RV.
ऋजिष्ठ See ऋजु॑.
ऋजीक mfn. (√ ऋज्, Uṇ. iv, 22; v, 51) (= उप-हत) hid, concealed
removed, obviated?
ऋजीक m. smoke
Indra
ऋजीक n. a means, expedient, according to Sāy. in आविर्-ऋजीक, q.v.
ऋ॑जीति mfn. (fr. ऋजु and √ इ, Sāy.), going or tending upwards, RV.
ऋजीयस् See ऋजु॑.
1. ऋजीष॑ अस्, m. (√ ऋज्), expeller (of enemies), N. of Indra [Sāy.], RV. i, 32, 6.
2. ऋजीष अम्, n. (√ अर्ज्, Uṇ. iv, 28), the sediment or residue of Soma, the Soma plant after the juice has been pressed out, AV. ix, 6, 16; VS. xix, 72; TS. vi; ŚBr.; KātyŚr. &c.
the juice produced by the third pressure of the plant, Sāy.
a frying-pan, Uṇ.
a particular hell, Mn. iv, 90.
ऋजीषित mfn. possessed of the residue of Soma g. तारकादि, Pāṇ. v, 2, 36.
ऋजीषि॑न् mfn. receiving the residue of Soma or the juice produced by the third pressure of the plant [Sāy.] N. of Indra and of the Maruts, RV.
having or consisting of the residue, TS.
